title: Multi-step flow
name: multiStepFlow
english: Walk through the steps of a flow in order, leaving a step only when its check passes.

inputs.name: steps
inputs.sentence: The steps in order, each with its own check.

inputs.name: data
inputs.sentence: What the flow collects along the way.

outputs.name: currentStep
outputs.sentence: The step on screen, or done.

outputs.name: blocked
outputs.sentence: The step whose check stopped the last NEXT.

outputs.name: progress
outputs.sentence: How far along the flow is, from 0 to 1.

outputs.name: xstateConfig
outputs.sentence: The same flow as an xstate machine config.

events.sentence: The person continues to the next step.
The person goes back a step.
The person jumps to a step already reached.

wraps.concept: createMachine with one state per step, guarded NEXT transitions, BACK, and a final state
wraps.adapter: The toXStateConfig helper gives the createMachine config; xstate's own assign is passed in, so the atom does not import xstate.

phrases: add a checkout flow with steps

signals.sentence: This function moves between the steps of a flow with a counter by hand.
